blurb:
Hello, and thank you for considering using my service! Firstly, I am the owner / operator and I do all of my own tours (and stunts ;) you get me, not a driver/employee! Which means I have limited availability, and can only do one or two tours / cruise transfers on any given day! (book early :) I'm very communicative, flexible and here to make sure you have a memorable and fun experience! 

Originally from Houston, Texas & South Florida, moved to Alaska years ago and fell in love with this industry! (worked for leading companies here - guided for over 10,000 visitors) As an award winning comedian, I combine comedy with a fervent love of Alaskan history and this is all incorporated into your tour! I currently have all 5 star reviews here! (over 30 on Viator & Trip Advisor, some of my listings are newer and might not show reviews, yet!) Book with confidence!
